rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a container or someone’s hands are filled to capacity.

example.jyutping: go3 doi6 ji5 ging1 mun5 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone has eaten enough and feels full.
Use this mainly in set attributive expressions such as 全長 for the entire length; casual speech often uses 成個 or 全部 instead.

example.english: The rope has a full length of ten metres.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sing4 cyun4 coeng4 sap6 mai5

rows.note: Use this when something is complete and no part or detail has been omitted.

example.english: I need a full, complete report.
example.traditional: 我需要一份完整嘅報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 fan6 jyun4 zing2 ge3 bou3 gou3
